canDoYue: 你識話禮物未過限額、打開袋畀人睇手錶收據、同埋喺櫃檯交酒類關稅。
canDoEn: Say the gifts are under the limit, open the bag and show the watch receipt, and pay the duty on the alcohol at the counter.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Do I need to declare these gifts if they are under the limit?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果呢啲禮物未過限額，我使唔使申報？
dialogue.say: Do I need to declare these gifts if they are under the limit?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: No. Gifts under that limit can skip the whole written customs form.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔使。禮物未過嗰個限額就可以唔填海關表。
dialogue.say: No. Gifts under that limit can skip the whole written customs form.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Should I open this bag now, and is the watch receipt enough?
dialogue.glossYue: 我而家開呢個袋，手錶嘅收據夠唔夠？
dialogue.say: Should I open this bag now, and is the watch receipt enough?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. Open it and show me the watch receipt in the pocket.
dialogue.glossYue: 夠。打開佢，畀我睇口袋入面手錶嘅收據。
dialogue.say: Yes. Open it and show me the watch receipt in the pocket.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: This bottle of alcohol is over the allowance. What should I pay?
dialogue.glossYue: 呢枝酒過咗限額。我應該畀幾多？
dialogue.say: This bottle of alcohol is over the allowance. What should I pay?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: You should pay forty dollars in cash because that alcohol is well over.
dialogue.glossYue: 因為酒過咗限額，你應該畀四十蚊現金。
dialogue.say: You should pay forty dollars in cash because that alcohol is well over.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I pay the duty at this counter before I leave, please?
dialogue.glossYue: 我可唔可以喺呢個櫃檯交關稅先走？
dialogue.say: Can I pay the duty at this counter before I leave, please?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. The duty is paid at this counter now, so keep the slip.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。關稅而家喺呢個櫃檯交，留低張單。
dialogue.say: Yes. The duty is paid at this counter now, so keep the slip.
